basic_details.job_title: IIM Ahmedabad Predoctoral Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad (IIM Ahmedabad) has released the recruitment notification for Predoctoral Research Assistant posts on a contract basis. Candidates applying for the Predoctoral Research Assistant position must hold a Bachelor's degree in Economics or a related discipline with high quantitative and/or mathematical content. The initial appointment is for eleven months, with pay as per IIMA norms. Eligible applicants can apply online by filling out the application form and uploading their CV, or alternatively email their CV and other application materials to Ms. Jinal Soni

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form at the online link provided.
Upload your CV and optional writing sample on the application form.
Alternatively, email your CV and other application materials to Ms. Jinal Soni at [email protected].
Include the subject line "Predoc Application" if applying via email.

content_sections.heading: IIM Ahmedabad Predoctoral Research Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Empirical research involving large datasets, regression analysis, and estimating choice models

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have at least a bachelor's degree in Economics or a related discipline with high quantitative and/or mathematical content. A master's degree will be preferred. Applicants should have some experience conducting economic analysis, such as estimating regression models with observational data, and be comfortable programming in Stata, R, or Python. Experience with discrete choice models or other structural methods would be appreciated, along with an expected interest in energy, environmental, or urban economics.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial appointment is for eleven months, subject to satisfactory progress, with the possibility of extension based on performance and future opportunities. Compensation is provided as per IIMA norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Ahmedabad Predoctoral Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form at the online link provided. Upload your CV and optional writing sample on the application form. Alternatively, email your CV and other application materials to Ms. Jinal Soni at [email protected] . Include the subject line "Predoc Application" if applying via email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted applicants will be tested on the abilities needed for the work described. Candidates in the final stage will be interviewed. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.
